readings.evidence: The native tile with origin (0,1608) shows a small dot at tile position (360,~1310). That is canvas position (~360,~2918). It lies in the strip left of the gutter (gutter at about x 430–460), level with the e. 77 row. No mark is visible near (355,1995). It is not text and has no attachment.

The note is small, raised and written after 'Bhāgavatapurāṇa [?]'. It is unclear whether it is a macron or a ligature on 'Varāh'. On fol. 335b, d. 1070(3) reads 'Viśvāmitramakharakṣaṇa by Janārdana s/o Bāla. Lith. n.d.: 2: 18: D.', with an arrow at the right. The 'Cf.' cites the shelfmark. The page does not show whether 'Varāhajayantīkathā ?' names 1070(3) or another text.
The ink number below the pencil '335' is heavily overwritten and underlined. The first two strokes look like '33'. The third is a blotted horizontal form and cannot be read.
The final letter before the full stop has a looped e-like form. It looks more like 'e' than the open 'a' forms used elsewhere on the page.
